model_name: BTC 15m Boundary Hybrid — Fixed Threshold Deployment
purpose: At the exact opening boundary of a new 15-minute BTC candle, output YES/GREEN, NO/RED, or SKIP without using any data from the target candle.

important_distinction.frozen_weights: The coefficients in this JSON are one final model fit on all 171 clean labeled rows.
important_distinction.validation: The reported 72.46% result came from expanding-window walk-forward retraining. No single frozen coefficient set generated every walk-forward prediction.
important_distinction.deployment_use: Use these frozen weights for immediate inference. To replicate the historical validation protocol, periodically retrain with the recipe in retraining_and_validation.

excluded.reason: status labeled but realized OHLC missing

target_definition.doji_policy: Do not train or score performance on exact doji outcomes. The supplied clean training rows contained no valid-OHLC dojis.

timing_contract.target_timestamp_meaning: Opening timestamp of the 15-minute candle being predicted.
allowed_information: Raw engine values finalized before the target boundary
Approximately 14-minute snapshot of the immediately preceding candle
Realized OHLC from candles strictly before the target timestamp
forbidden_information: actual_open, actual_high, actual_low, or actual_close of the target candle
actual_direction or result/status derived from the target candle
Any tick, partial candle, order book, volume, or price update occurring after the target boundary
timing_contract.partial_snapshot_semantics: current_partial_snapshot_json must describe the immediately preceding 15-minute candle near minute 14, not the target candle.

stateful_sequence.description: Pass chronological historical rows plus the current unlabeled boundary row. Generate lag features exactly as specified.

direct_vector_mode.description: Alternatively produce an exact 205-element vector aligned to feature_order, then apply standardization and logistic scoring.

feature_engineering.gap_policy: While walking backward, stop at the first row without valid realized OHLC; do not bridge the gap.

numeric_missing_policy.rule: For every raw numeric and lag numeric feature: if missing/non-finite, omit the numeric feature and set <feature>__missing = 1.0. If present, set the numeric feature and leave its missing indicator absent/0.
numeric_missing_policy.derived_feature_missing_rule: Derived EMA/range, partial-snapshot, module, and time features follow the exact rules below; no extra missing indicator is added unless it exists in feature_order.

categorical_policy.unknown_category: It will not exist in feature_order and therefore contributes 0.0. Log and monitor unknown categories.

prior_completed_candle_features._lag_prev_dir: green if prior close > prior open else red; missing if no immediately prior valid candle

rolling_lag_features._lag_green_count_N: Count of completed candles with close > open among newest N.
rolling_lag_features._lag_range_ratio_N: Newest candle range_pct / (mean range_pct of the other N-1 candles + 1e-9).
rolling_lag_features._lag_streak_len: Length of same-direction streak beginning with the newest completed candle.
rolling_lag_features._lag_streak_dir: green or red direction of that newest streak.
rolling_lag_features._lag_close_pos_8: (newest close - min(low newest 8)) / (max(high newest 8) - min(low newest 8) + 1e-9).
rolling_lag_features.insufficient_history: Set affected numeric lag feature to missing and encode its __missing indicator; categorical streak direction becomes missing.

price_and_ema_features.guard: Only compute when btc_price_at_prediction is nonzero and required source value exists.

partial_snapshot_features.source: Parse current_partial_snapshot_json keys open, high, low, close and optional volume.
partial_snapshot_features.parse_failure: Omit these derived features, which leaves their aligned vector values at 0 before standardization.

module_features.source: Parse module_points_json as an object keyed by each fixed_module_name.
module_features.value: float(points[module][side]); default 0.0 on missing/invalid side value.

time_features.minute_of_day: UTC hour * 60 + UTC minute from candle_ts_utc

hard_no_overrides.application_order: Apply after the probability-based base decision. Any matching rule forces final_decision=NO, including when base decision is YES or SKIP.

reference_pseudocode: annotate each row with valid_target = nonblank(actual_open) AND nonblank(actual_close)
for live row: derive lag features from strictly earlier valid completed candles; stop at first invalid row
feature_map = build raw numeric, categorical, derived price/EMA, prior-candle, rolling-lag, partial-snapshot, module, and time features
for j in 0..204: z[j] = (x[j] - feature_means[j]) / feature_scales[j]
base = YES if p_green >= 0.58 else NO if p_green <= 0.26 else SKIP
if prediction == "NO CLEAR EDGE" OR market_condition == "trending_expansion" OR lowercase(failed_breakout_down) == "true": final = NO else final = base
return p_green, base, override flags/reasons, final

recommended_live_retraining_recipe.retrain_cadence: Every 12 newly resolved valid candles, or on a slower controlled release cadence.
recommended_live_retraining_recipe.training_set: All clean labeled rows strictly before the first candle that will use the new model.
recommended_live_retraining_recipe.feature_pipeline: Rebuild DictVectorizer vocabulary, StandardScaler, and LogisticRegression from the training set using the exact settings in this JSON.
recommended_live_retraining_recipe.thresholds: Keep locked at YES=0.58 and NO=0.26 unless a separately versioned validation approves a change.
recommended_live_retraining_recipe.deployment_safety: Never select thresholds or weights using outcomes from candles that the candidate model is supposed to predict.

adaptive_threshold_historical_comparison.warning: Do not describe this as the fixed-threshold model.
adaptive_threshold_historical_comparison.threshold_selection: Threshold pair was reselected using only earlier inner-validation data before each outer block; outer block outcomes were not visible.

limitations: Only 171 clean labeled candles and approximately 43 hours of market history.
The 72.46% figure is selective accuracy on 69 trades, not accuracy on all 99 opportunities.
No fees, spread, payout price, slippage, latency, or market capacity were modeled.
Several raw input fields come from the upstream signal engine; backend values must preserve their original semantics.
Unknown categorical values contribute zero because they are absent from the frozen vectorizer vocabulary.
Performance can decay under different volatility, exchange, or market-regime conditions.
